title: 4 Hour Private Wakesurf Charter With Captain Lake Tahoe
includes: Variety of boards , and lifejackets as well as ropes and all other equipment needed.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
What better way to cool off and spend your summer day than on the lake, taking in the stunning scenery and crystal-clear emerald waters Lake Tahoe is known for. With the option to cruise, sightsee, swim, lounge, wake surf, wakeboard or tube, we offer the most versatile boating lake day experience. Our top-of-the-line MB Wakeboat provides the best of functionality, speed, comfort, an amazing sound system, and massive wake. Don't be left in the wake on a slow and boring pontoon boat! Wake surfing is a rapidly growing sport that is beginner friendly, low impact, and something the whole family can enjoy.

Never wake surfed before? Not a problem! We have the equipment, coaching and atmosphere you need to learn and excel! We will be right by your side with helpful tips, feedback, and encouragement to get you up and riding in no time, or further progress your current skills.
